outcome: Adverse event reports (including headache, injection site erythema, injection site pain, preterm birth, preterm premature rupture of membranes, caesarean section, cervical dilatation, haemorrhage during pregnancy, uterine contractions during pregnancy)
cohort: The study included all adverse event reports submitted to the U.S. VAERS database concerning pregnant individuals following RSVpreF vaccination.
finding: The analysis highlighted a previously observed safety signal for preterm birth, with reports of preterm birth in conjunction with RSVpreF vaccination observed more frequently than statistically expected.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was reported as a pregnancy-specific adverse event in 3.3% of cases following RSVpreF vaccination.
gest_age: Gestational age at vaccination was assessed; most reported preterm births occurred between 32 and less than 37 weeks of gestation.
